|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Jedi Lightsaber (V) (ALT) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee high-resolution card image of this version ([[:File:V11-L-jedilightsaber_ai-2025-02-20-hires.png]]); no card-size GIF of this image was ever committed, which is why it was missing from the version list until the PC's high-resolution images were compared with the card-size images (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Each version below is a published PC printing; card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository. Every visibly different printing is a separate version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026); a later copy of the same image in another format is not (13 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC high-resolution card image uploaded 20 February 2025<ref name="img-altpng-6d0875f-jedilightsaberaipng">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/jedilightsaber_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image) in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6d0875f78ed268d138f6b4466a46654409fc6353 commit 6d0875f] (20 February 2025) (“More AIs for GEMP Series 7”). No card-size GIF of this image was committed (the card-size image <code>large/…</code> was never made from it); the PC served this PNG at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/jedilightsaber_ai.png until it was replaced (today's copy is the latest version only), and GEMP showed the high-resolution image.</ref>. The earliest published image of this card: it was only ever committed as a high-resolution PNG, so version lists built from the card-size images missed it (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; label “(AI)”; bottom margin “Jedi Lightsaber”. Text: “Deploy on your character of ability > 4 or Padawan. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if total destiny > defense value.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Jedi Lightsaber (V) (ALT) (Errata)]]): '''What changed''' (compared with the previous version, the high-resolution image of 20 February 2025): the label “(AI)” → “(ALT)”. PC card image uploaded 20 January 2026<ref name="img-altpng-6cae8c9-large">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/jedilightsaber_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6cae8c9ca0ffa879985fee5c01eca246364add0d commit 6cae8c9] (20 January 2026); the PC serves the latest version of each file at res.starwarsccg.org/cards/. The commit date is the upload date.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; label “(ALT)”; bottom margin “Jedi Lightsaber”. It is the current image. Text: “Deploy on your character of ability &gt; 4 or Padawan. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if total destiny &gt; defense value.”
